answer: To construct an unforgeable Sybil defense for autonomous agents, we embed an immutable kernel within recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments that verify historical proof-of-work without revealing source states. By tethering state transitions to sequential verifiable delay functions that spark a cryptographic ember, any attempt at parallel identity cloning creates an untenable computational deficit. This forms an economic oasis where forging identities is rendered provably intractable against polynomially bounded adversaries.
